description: Taboola browser event pixels on /log/3/unip. Taboola documents the en event name on the query. Generated pixels send revenue, currency, quantity, and orderid under those same names. The tfa.js loader is vendor/taboola. S2S postbacks are vendor/taboola-s2s.

params.name: en
params.description: It is the event name. Taboola documents verifying event pixels by a unip request that carries `en`.
params.fix_hint: Send `en` with the Realize event name, such as `page_view` or `purchase`.

params.name: revenue
params.description: It is the conversion value. Taboola documents an integer or decimal number, with no commas. Page views omit it.
params.fix_hint: Send a number, such as `9.99`, or drop the pair on a page view.

params.name: currency
params.description: It is the revenue currency. Taboola documents a fixed list of three-letter codes, case-sensitive. Omit it to use the account default.
params.fix_hint: Use a documented code such as `USD`.

params.name: quantity
params.description: It is the item quantity in the order. Taboola documents an integer.
params.fix_hint: Send an integer quantity, such as `3`.

params.name: orderid
params.description: It is an order ID from the advertiser CRM. Taboola documents it as optional. Purchase fires often send it.
params.fix_hint: Set orderid to the CRM order ID, or drop the pair.
